description:
After Ye's birthday party in June 2023, Ye would begin to executive produce Ty Dolla $ign's album Beach House 4, with Ty being flown out to Japan to work with Ye. This work would eventually turn into a full-on collaborative album, with them going to Italy to work on music on July 27th, 2023. A video of Ye and Ty listening to "BACK TO ME" was posted by TMZ on October 2nd, 2023, with Ty confirming a joint album on Instagram. Ty would later say in an interview that the two went through their hard drives to find all their best material to speed up the process. The single "Vultures" would release on November 11th, 2023, marking a sound shift and a rename to VULTURES 1.

description: The adidas Yeezy Slide Infant ‘Desert Sand’ brings a spartan aesthetic to little feet, highlighted by a monochromatic neutral finish on a lightweight EVA build. title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infants ‘Beluga Reflective’ delivers a slightly modified version of the sneaker’s original 2016 colorway. Scaled down for little feet, the minimalist silhouette features breathable Primeknit construction in a predominantly grey finish, contrasted by a vibrant orange side stripe marked with SPLY-350 branding. This updated design integrates reflective fibers throughout the breathable knit build, adding a hi-vis element to the sock-like upper. A caged Boost midsole delivers lightweight cushioning with each step.
